resources.string: No ECU detected - check the cable and key
ECU IS NOT LOGGING\nThe card is mounted to the phone. Use \"Return to ECU\" before driving.
Ask how far back when more than %1$d new logs (copy all after %2$d s)
The ECU is not logging while this runs.\nCancelling is safe - finished files are kept and the rest resume next time.
\u2713 SAFE TO UNPLUG\nThe ECU has its card back and is logging.
You can leave. Finishing the file check on the phone \u2013 the ECU is not needed for this.
ECU firmware: shown after the first live log

Read-only, like TunerStudio: the ECU keeps logging to its own SD card. Nothing is mounted or copied. The first log for a firmware reads its .ini from the ECU itself (or downloads it); later ones use the saved copy. If that fails, load the .ini by hand.
Live logging in progress.\nStop it on the Live Log tab to sync logs or use the card controls.
A sync is running. Live logging is available when it finishes.
